video_title: The NBA allowed fans to assault Stephen Jackson, Ron Artest in the Malice it the Palace 👀

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on the unfair suspension following the Malice at the Palace
quotes.excerpt: If David Stern wasn't trying to change the dress code and change the way the league was looking

text_blocks.speaker: Stephen Jackson
text_blocks.text: If David Stern wasn't trying to change the dress code and change the way the league was looking at the time, we wouldn't have got fined. We fell into all that. That's why we got suspended so much, because we were at work. We were on the road in the stadium.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson argues that throwing beer at players is assault
quotes.excerpt: If a beer is thrown in anybody's face today outside of here, that's assault on any other person.
quotes.quote: If a beer is thrown in anybody's face today outside of here, that's assault on any other person. Throw one beer in his face. We all run up there to grab. If you look up there, I ran, as soon as I get up there, I grab Ron to try to grab him and hold him. But as I grab him, the guy in front of me throws another beer in his face. That's two assaults on this man.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on being suspended for defending his teammate
quotes.excerpt: I get suspended 30 games for one punch because I'm at work with my teammates.
quotes.quote: I get suspended 30 games for one punch because I'm at work with my teammates and we're fighting 30,000 people. But we get suspended? You don't care about your players. And see, that's when you look at the game like, damn, this looks like slave. You just use us for what you need us for, but when we need y'all to have our back and protect us, y'all are saying fuck us. Y'all are making it worse on us. And that's what they did.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on Ron Artest's potential as a defensive player
quotes.excerpt: Ron could have been defensive player and MVP at least two, three years if his mind was right.
quotes.quote: Ron could have been defensive player and MVP at least two, three years if his mind was right. That one punch, I missed three, four All-Star games. If you look at my career, I got an MVP vote. How I wasn't an All-Star? I was averaging dubs. I was bringing teams that never been to the playoffs to the playoffs my first year there. I did it with two teams, leading the teams.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on the team's bond during the 2004 season
quotes.excerpt: This is our family. How can we not protect each other?
quotes.quote: That shit, the way they handled the brawl, it put us in a light that we shouldn't have been in. Because we were at work. What else we supposed to do? It's 15 of us. We together six months, more than we with our own families. So this is our family. How can we not protect each other? We get fined for protecting each other on the road. So it would have been cool if we would have said, 'Fuck it, let's not run in the stands and Ron up there dead.' It's cool. Nah, we ain't them type of niggas.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on the Pacers being the best team in the league
quotes.excerpt: We were the best team in the league that day.
quotes.quote: What people don't bring up, we were the best team in the league that day. Not only that day, but they knew going into that game we were the best team in the league. We had beat everybody, we had a great record, and this was our test to see who was the best in the East. And we beat that ass. No, spanked them niggas on national TV.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on the rivalry with the Detroit Pistons
quotes.excerpt: I hear Jermaine tell Ron, 'You can get your foul.'
quotes.quote: I'm going to the free throw line, and I hear Jermaine tell Ron, 'You can get your foul.' So, you know, they played in the Eastern Conference Finals. I walked into a rivalry. This is my first year, but they had just beat them in the East. So I'm cool with ripping my teammate. I'm cool with it. Like, I'm not on that. I'm just hooping. I'm not on that with Tayshaun. That's my boy. She, my partner. I'm not on that.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson reveals Ron Artest had a death in the family
quotes.excerpt: What people don't know is Ron had just had a death in the family.
quotes.quote: What people don't know is Ron had just had a death in the family. So Ron wasn't even supposed to play around. He wasn't even supposed to play, I don't think. He showed up and played. And that's my guy. I didn't have no problem with Ron, so I didn't know what it was. So I knew if Ron went there, nigga, you know Ron. Yeah, you know what's coming with it, bro. Grown man, strong country nigga strength. You know what's coming with this, bro. So this what you want to do?

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on Ron Artest's personality and the brawl's impact
quotes.excerpt: Ron really ain't no hater. He ain't no type of nigga, he ain't no confrontation nigga.
quotes.quote: Ron really ain't no hater. He ain't no type of nigga, he ain't no confrontation nigga. He's one of the coolest niggas ever, dog. That's why I didn't understand it. It was some shit that him and Ron, I didn't understand it, bro. But that shit fucked up our season, bro. That fucked, because that was a championship for us. But I'm telling you, bro, could nobody beat us in seven games.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on the Pacers' roster depth and talent
quotes.excerpt: We had two of the most hustling motherfuckers and best defender white boys in the game.
quotes.quote: We had two of the most hustling motherfuckers and best defender white boys in the game, Jeff Foster and Scot Pollard. They getting all the rebounds, getting all the charges, they doing all the dirty work. You got Jermaine, All-Star, one of the best power forwards ever. You got Reggie Miller. You got Ron, one of the best two-way players to ever touch the NBA. We had everything. Jamal Tinsley, that point guard. We had 10-point guard, one of the best post-up point guards I've ever seen in my life.

quotes.speaker: Stephen Jackson
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Jackson on the car accident that knocked out his teeth
quotes.excerpt: I ended up getting me hit by a car, knocked all my teeth out.
quotes.quote: I don't think I had to go from zero to 100, but I just saw my teammate in harm's way and went from, you don't get a chance to think if you can go zero or five or 10% the second somebody be dead. I reacted quick, ended up getting me hit by a car, knocked all my teeth out. I had to have plastic surgery on my lips with no anesthesia for two hours because my lips were so swollen that if they would have added the numbness, my lips probably would have burst.
